doubts.claim_under_doubt: The code-review remediation's escape-aware split (`_split_row_cells`, a single-char `(?<!\\)\|` lookbehind) closes the column-misalignment class for any title containing a `|`.
doubts.disproof_attempt: A single-char lookbehind only inspects the ONE char preceding a `|`. A title ending in an unescaped, unpadded literal backslash directly adjacent to the real delimiter (e.g. a hand-edited row) still merges the next cell into the title, silently corrupting depends_on with no error. Concrete repro traced by hand and confirmed by a failing regression test before the fix.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Escape `\` itself (`\` -> `\\`, ahead of `|` -> `\|`) at write time, and read with a pair-consuming scan (`\` + next char is always one unit) instead of a fixed-width lookbehind.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Multiple literal `|` characters within one title cell, and consecutive escaped pipes, round-trip correctly through the escape/unescape pair.
doubts.disproof_attempt: Traced by hand across both the escape and split/unescape steps; no failure found. Recorded as an attempted-and-failed disproof, not a live issue.

remediation: HIGH-severity doubt (medium in the reviewer's own scale) fixed in the same sub-iterate: campaign_init.py now escapes `\` -> `\\` ahead of `|` -> `\|` at write time; campaign_status.py's `_split_row_cells` rewritten around a pair-consuming scan (any `\` plus the next char is one unit, not a fixed-width lookbehind) plus a new `_unescape_cell` helper that reverses both escapes in one pass. Verified with new regression tests at both the campaign_init round-trip level and the parser level directly (hand-crafted markdown with an escaped pipe and with an escaped trailing backslash adjacent to a real delimiter), full shared + plugin test suites green, ruff clean. The low-severity multi-pipe doubt required no change (already correct). All other lenses (concurrency/resume-safety, ADR-045 module-identity, hidden coupling) were attacked and no new break was found beyond what prior review rounds already covered and the campaign owner already accepted in the run ADR.
